##Set up a vector named age, consisting of 34, 28, 22, 36, 27, 18, 52, 39, 42,
29, 35, 31, 27, 22, 37, 34, 19, 20, 57, 49, 50, 37, 46, 25, 17, 37, 42,
53, 41, 51, 35, 24, 33, 41.
```{r}
age <- c(34, 28, 22, 36, 27, 18, 52, 39, 42, 29, 35, 31, 27, 22, 37, 34, 19, 20, 57, 49, 50, 37, 46, 25, 17, 37, 42, 53, 41, 51, 35, 24, 33, 41)	
data_points_age <- length(age)
print(data_points_age)
```

```{r}
reciprocal_age <- 1 / age	
reciprocal_age
```

```{r}
new_age <- c(age, 0, age)	
print(new_age)
print(length(new_age))
```

```{r}
sorted_age <- sort(age)
print(sorted_age)
```

```{r}
minimum_age <- min(age)
maximum_age <- max(age)
cat("Minimum Age:", minimum_age, "\n")
cat("Maximum Age:", maximum_age, "\n")
```

```{r}
data <- c(2.4, 2.8, 2.1, 2.5, 2.4, 2.2, 2.5, 2.3, 2.5, 2.3, 2.4, 2.7)
num_data_points <- length(data)
cat("The vector 'data' is:\n")
print(data)
cat("\nNumber of data points (length(data)):\n")
print(num_data_points)
```

```{r}
doubled_data <- data * 2
cat("Original 'data' vector:\n")
print(data)
cat("\n'doubled_data' vector (data * 2):\n")
print(doubled_data)
```

```{r}
seq_8_1 <- 1:100
cat("8.1 Integers from 1 to 100 (Showing first 6 elements):\n")
print(head(seq_8_1))
cat("Length of sequence 8.1:", length(seq_8_1), "\n\n")
```

```{r}
seq_8_2 <- 20:60
cat("8.2 Numbers from 20 to 60:\n")
print(seq_8_2)
cat("Length of sequence 8.2:", length(seq_8_2), "\n\n")
```

```{r}
mean_8_3 <- mean(20:60)
cat("8.3 Mean of numbers from 20 to 60:\n")
print(mean_8_3)
cat("Number of data points for 8.3 (a single value):", 1, "\n\n")
```

```{r}
sum_8_4 <- sum(51:91)
cat("8.4 Sum of numbers from 51 to 91:\n")
print(sum_8_4)
cat("Number of data points for 8.4 (a single value):", 1, "\n")
```

```{r}
filtered_vector <- Filter(function(i) { all(i %% c(3,5,7) != 0) }, seq(100))
cat("Integers between 1 and 100 not divisible by 3, 5, or 7:\n")
print(filtered_vector)
```

```{r}
reverse_sequence <- 100:1
cat("Sequence of integers from 100 down to 1:\n")
print(reverse_sequence)
```

```{r}
numbers_below_25 <- 1:25
multiples_list <- numbers_below_25[ (numbers_below_25 %% 3 == 0) | (numbers_below_25 %% 5 == 0) ]
cat("List of natural numbers below 25 that are multiples of 3 or 5:\n")
print(multiples_list)

multiples_list <- numbers_to_25[ (numbers_to_25 %% 3 == 0) | (numbers_to_25 %% 5 == 0) ]
cat("10. List of multiples of 3 or 5 below 25 (11 data points):\n")
print(multiples_list)
```

```{r}
multiples_sum <- sum(multiples_list)
cat("\n11. Sum of these multiples (1 data point):\n")
print(multiples_sum)
```

```{r}
score <- c(72, 86, 92, 63, 88, 89, 91, 92, 75, 75, 77)
element_2 <- score[2]
element_3 <- score[3]
cat("The score vector is:\n")
print(score)
cat("\nElement at index 2 (score[2]):\n")
print(element_2)
cat("\nElement at index 3 (score[3]):\n")
print(element_3)
```

```{r}
a <- c(1, 2, NA, 4, NA, 6, 7)
cat("Output using print(a, na.print=\"-999\"):\n")
print(a, na.print="-999")
cat("\nActual data in vector 'a' remains unchanged:\n")
print(a)
```

```{r}
x <- c(2, 3, 4)
cat("Initial class of x:\n")
initial_class <- class(x)
print(initial_class)
class(x) <- "foo"
cat("\nNew class of x after assignment:\n")
new_class <- class(x)
print(new_class)
```
